main.mispar_rechev: skip: licence plate, a per-vehicle lookup identifier; never shown (the shell's explorer serves the lookup)
main.misgeret: skip: chassis (VIN) number, a per-vehicle identifier; never shown
main.mispar_manoa: skip: engine serial number, a per-vehicle identifier; never shown
main.tozeret_cd: skip: numeric maker code, one-to-one with tozeret_nm which is shown
main.tozeret_nm: chart-brands, chart-shift, chart-models, insight:brand, insight:shift, insight:model — maker = name without the truncated plant country, so one maker's plants are merged
main.degem_cd: skip: numeric model code, 15-42% empty and meaningless without the maker's code table
main.degem_nm: skip: ~28,000 factory model codes (BK12Z…); kinuy_mishari carries the readable name
main.sug_rechev_cd: skip: numeric vehicle-type code, one-to-one with sug_rechev_nm which is shown
main.sug_rechev_nm: chart-types, insight:types — 300+ type names folded into 7 families by name prefix
main.moed_aliya_lakvish: skip: first-road year is empty for 53-99% of rows depending on the file; shnat_yitzur covers vehicle age
main.bitul_dt: chart-yearly, chart-monthly, chart-heat, chart-age-trend, chart-age-hist, chart-types, chart-shift, chart-ev, chart-owner, chart-days, kpi:ytd, kpi:ytd_change, kpi:med_age, insight:ytd, insight:long, insight:outlier, insight:season, insight:day — cancellation date drives every time view
main.tozar_manoa: skip: engine maker free text with thousands of spellings; tozeret_nm covers the maker
main.degem_manoa: skip: ~14,000 engine-model codes, meaningless without a lookup
main.mishkal_kolel: skip: total weight is 0 (unknown) for ~40% of rows and has placeholder values like 99999
main.ramat_gimur: skip: free-text trim levels (GLX, LX…), 20-55% empty, no meaning across makers
main.ramat_eivzur_betihuty: skip: safety-equipment level is 0 for over 98% of rows
main.kvutzat_zihum: skip: pollution group is 0 (not recorded) for 76% of rows and almost all pre-2010 cancellations
main.shnat_yitzur: chart-age-trend, chart-age-hist, kpi:med_age, insight:age — age at cancellation = cancellation year minus production year
main.zmig_kidmi: skip: free-format tyre spec with thousands of spellings, technical
main.zmig_ahori: skip: free-format tyre spec, 11-27% empty, technical
main.sug_delek_nm: chart-ev, insight:ev — fuel table in the same section; spelling variants merged
main.horaat_rishum: skip: registration-directive number, 0 for 79% of rows
main.kinuy_mishari: chart-models, insight:model — trade name normalised across spellings; used from the first year it is filled for 75% of rows
main._resource_name: skip: names the source file (rolling file or a frozen archive split); the date column already orders the rows
